label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, leaning a1, earlier in episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (no activity at GO or D2), and almost only when the reward input shows the previous trial was unrewarded: prev_reward==0 covers 98.6% of activation mass, though only about 22% of such D1 steps fire. Among those, it prefers steps where the model policy leans toward a1 (choice logit > -1; upcoming action a1 holds 73% of the mass, and so does good=S1). It also fades steadily over the episode: rate about 6.6% in trials 0-9, near zero after trial 80, none in 90-99. The strongest activations come right after unrewarded trials early in an episode, often in losing streaks or right after the agent has switched to a1. It does not fire after rewarded trials, at fixation-free steps, or late in episodes. Precision stays low (about 0.45) because many unrewarded D1 steps with an a1 lean stay silent, especially after long rewarded streaks. Simpler predicate (D1 & prev_reward==0): recall 0.95, precision 0.22. Recorded predicate uses only observed or internal quantities (the reward input, the model own policy logit, trial index). Dev F1 0.57, mass recall 0.92.
